rows.commute: Workers 16+ by how they get to work

nativity.label: Born a U.S. citizen abroad or in a territory

rule.text: Figures are rounded with the largest-remainder method so each row adds up exactly. A specialist is a category whose share is at least 1.5× or at most 0.67× the national share (categories under 1% both here and nationally are skipped); up to 4 over- and 2 under-represented are listed. Micropolitan areas are marked unreliable: their 1-year margins of error are large. Commute shares are of workers, not of all residents.
